body.text: Turing Cup 2023 onsite round (Round-2 and Round-3) was held on March 25th, 2023 and it was a huge success. The top 60 participants from the first round were selected for round-2, and the top 10 teams from round-2 were shortlisted for round-3. The winners of the Turing Cup 2023 were:

items: Kishore Kumar and Vidit Jain, from IIIT Hyderabad

body.text: The winners appreciated the problem setting team, and stated that the problems in the contest were the best ones seen by them in the recent past. We'd like to congratulate all the participants for their enthusiasm.
